'''Andi Dae''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Dae worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], exporting native woods. Dae owned a warehouse in [[Gadrin]] and was ecologically-minded, so let the [[Bark Lovers' Alliance]], a local environmental group, use an office in the warehouse.
